text:
香港宏福苑火警獨立調查委員會  
Hong Kong Independent Committee on the Fire at Wang Fuk Court  

日期：2023年10月15日  
Date: 15 October 2023  

致：香港特別行政區政府  
To: The Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region  

主題：宏福苑火警調查報告初稿提交  
Subject: Submission of the Draft Report on the Wang Fuk Court Fire Investigation  

尊敬的先生/女士：  
Dear Sir/Madam,  

本委員會根據《香港特別行政區獨立調查條例》成立，負責調查2023年9月在大埔宏福苑發生的火警事故。經過詳細的現場勘察、證人訪問及專家分析，我們已完成調查報告的初稿。  

The Committee was established under the Independent Investigation Ordinance of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to investigate the fire incident at Wang Fuk Court, Tai Po, in September 2023. After thorough site inspections, witness interviews, and expert analyses, we have completed the draft report.  

附件中包含調查報告初稿全文，請查閱。報告涵蓋事故原因、應急反應、消防設施狀況及建議改進措施。  

The draft report is enclosed for your review. It covers the causes of the incident, emergency response, status of fire safety installations, and recommended improvements.  

敬請政府部門審閱並提出意見，以便本委員會進一步完善報告，並於最終報告中提交具體建議。  

We kindly request the government departments to review and provide feedback, so that the Committee can refine the report and submit concrete recommendations in the final version.  

此致  
敬禮  

委員會主席  
Chairperson of the Committee  

（簽名）  
(Signature)  

香港宏福苑火警獨立調查委員會印章  
Stamp of the Hong Kong Independent Committee on the Fire at Wang Fuk Court  

附件：宏福苑火警調查報告初稿全文  
Enclosure: Full Draft Report on the Wang Fuk Court Fire Investigation
